sentences.text: For this MSE business-loan case at a Tier 3 UCB, the current rule says any pre-payment charges, if any, must be as per the approved policy of the UCB.
The sanction letter states a pre-payment charge of 2% of the amount prepaid.

The evidence shows a separate bank policy for all term loans that levies foreclosure charges of 2% plus GST on the principal outstanding, but it does not show that this is the approved policy for the MSE business-loan sanction letter or whether that policy matches the sanction-letter wording.

missing.searched: Looked for a bank policy specifically governing MSE business-loan pre-payment charges and whether the sanction letter's 2% of amount prepaid clause is the approved policy required by the current UCB rule.
